title: Exploring Variational Auto-Encoder Architectures, Configurations, and Datasets for Generative Music Explainable AI
reasoning: The paper's focus on eXplainable AI (XAI) for generative music models aims to make AI more understandable and controllable by people, which is inherently tied to ethical considerations of transparency and accountability. Furthermore, it explicitly discusses bias in AI models towards certain musical styles, noting its impact on 'marginalised forms of music' and connecting this to 'Human-Centred AI' concerns.
